import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from factor_analyzer import FactorAnalyzer

water = pd.read_csv('/root/data/water_temperature.csv')
climate = pd.read_csv('/root/data/climate.csv')
hydro = pd.read_csv('/root/data/hydrology.csv')
land = pd.read_csv('/root/data/land_cover.csv')
df = water.merge(climate, on='Year', validate='one_to_one').merge(hydro, on='Year', validate='one_to_one').merge(land, on='Year', validate='one_to_one')
variables = ['AirTempLake','Shortwave','Longwave','Precip','Inflow','Outflow','WindSpeedLake','DevelopedArea','AgricultureArea']
categories = {'Heat': ['AirTempLake','Shortwave','Longwave'], 'Flow': ['Precip','Inflow','Outflow'], 'Wind': ['WindSpeedLake'], 'Human': ['DevelopedArea','AgricultureArea']}
fa = FactorAnalyzer(n_factors=4, rotation='varimax')
X=StandardScaler().fit_transform(df[variables])
fa.fit(X); scores = fa.transform(X)
loadings=pd.DataFrame(fa.loadings_,index=variables,columns=['F1','F2','F3','F4'])
print('LOADINGS\n',loadings.round(3))
print('\nSS CATEGORY LOADINGS')
for category, cat_variables in categories.items(): print(category,(loadings.loc[cat_variables]**2).sum().round(3).to_dict())

def r2(x):
 m=LinearRegression().fit(x,df.WaterTemperature); return m.score(x,df.WaterTemperature)
full=r2(scores); print('\nR2',full)
for index in range(4): print(index+1,full-r2(np.delete(scores,index,axis=1)))
print('\nFA variance',fa.get_factor_variance())

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from factor_analyzer import FactorAnalyzer

names=('water_temperature','climate','hydrology','land_cover')
df=pd.read_csv(f'/root/data/{names[0]}.csv')
for name in names[1:]: df=df.merge(pd.read_csv(f'/root/data/{name}.csv'),on='Year',validate='one_to_one')
variables=['AirTempLake','Shortwave','Longwave','Precip','Inflow','Outflow','WindSpeedLake','DevelopedArea','AgricultureArea']
fa=FactorAnalyzer(n_factors=4,rotation='varimax').fit(StandardScaler().fit_transform(df[variables]))
scores=fa.transform(StandardScaler().fit_transform(df[variables]))
def r2(indices): return LinearRegression().fit(scores[:,indices],df.WaterTemperature).score(scores[:,indices],df.WaterTemperature)
full=r2([0,1,2,3])
for name, remove in {'Flow':[0],'Heat':[1,3],'Human':[2],'Wind':[]}.items():
    keep=[index for index in range(4) if index not in remove]
    print(name, full-r2(keep))
